title: 11th Annual Black History Greens Festival
description: On Saturday, Feb. 28, the city of Santa Monica and the Black Santa Monica Community Group hosted the 11th annual Black History Greens Festival, a free community celebration that was part of the city’s Black History Month events. This year’s theme was "Boots on the Ground,” honoring community and culture.
transcript_text: Welcome Santa Monica. My name is Ebanicia Fischer and I'm Hajer and welcome to the 11th annual Black History Greens Festival at Virginia Avenue Park. We are the Black Santa Monica Community Group and we put on this event every year with the city of Santa Monica. Thank you for joining us for celebrating black American history, which is American history 100 years. Heat. Heat.
